description: GOWA - WhatsApp REST API with support for UI, Multi Account, Webhooks, and MCP, and Chatwoot. Built with Golang for efficient memory use.

latest_release.name: v9.11.0
latest_release.body:
## What's New in v9.11.0

**📞 Incoming Call Logs, Local Timezones & More Reliable Chatwoot Routing**

GOWA can now list incoming calls per device and return chat and newsletter timestamps in a configured timezone. This release also improves WhatsApp number resolution, preserves group names and media filenames, and helps inbound Chatwoot replies reach the right conversation.

---

## ✨ Features

### Incoming Call Logs ([#828](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/828))

- Use `GET /call/logs` to list incoming calls recorded for the selected device, newest first. Use `limit` and `offset` for pagination and `chat_jid` to filter by chat.

### Configurable API Timezone ([#981](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/981))

- Set `APP_TIMEZONE` or pass `--timezone` with an IANA name such as `Asia/Jakarta` to display chat, message, reaction, and newsletter timestamps in that zone in REST and MCP responses.
- Message queries now compare time bounds in UTC, so a filter with an explicit offset selects the intended window.

### Descriptive Media Filenames ([#945](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/945))

- Chatwoot REST uploads retain descriptive filenames and resolved file extensions. Common audio and video uploads have MIME fallbacks when the host MIME database is unavailable.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### WhatsApp Number Resolution ([#982](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/982))

- Use the phone JID registered by WhatsApp for sends and related chat operations, including when WhatsApp resolves the entered number to a different spelling.
- Return an error when the account lookup fails and HTTP `400` when `/user/check` receives a malformed number. Honor an explicit `duration=0` when sending text to a chat with a stored disappearing-message timer.

### Group Names and Participant Phone Numbers ([#929](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/929), [#975](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/975))

- Preserve group names per device, including renames and names received during history sync.
- Leave a participant's `phone_number` empty when WhatsApp supplies only a LID and the phone number is unknown.

### Chatwoot Reply Routing ([#979](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/979))

- When an exact phone lookup misses, identify the Chatwoot contact from a stored link to a delivered agent message. GOWA checks the quoted agent reply first, then the latest matching delivered reply for the same device, chat, configuration, account, and inbox.

### Group Call Webhook Filtering ([#984](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/984))

- Match `group_jid` on group `call.offer` events against `WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_IGNORE_JIDS`, including the `@g.us` wildcard.

---

## 🔧 Technical Improvements

- Update whatsmeow to revision `494ae5d707ac`, Fiber to `v3.7.0`, `mcp-go` to `v1.6.0`, and refresh other Go dependencies. ([b683a0f](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/commit/b683a0f), [3283f00](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/commit/3283f00))
- Convert the README's breaking changes to a table and point readers to the [public GOWA documentation](https://gowa-docs.mintlify.site/). ([8c71f80](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/commit/8c71f80))

## Upgrade Notes

- API responses default to UTC when the timezone setting is unset. Use a valid IANA name when configuring it. Storage and webhook timestamps remain UTC.
- Call logs cover incoming offers recorded while the device was connected. Outgoing calls, duration, and answered or ended status are outside the recorded data.
- Treat downloaded media paths as opaque. The filename now includes a unique prefix and a sanitized display name.
- Consumers of group participant data should accept an empty `phone_number` for LID-only participants.
- Chatwoot r

hot_issues.title: 🐞  Some clients receive messages stuck on “Waiting for message” status
feat(auth): restrict Basic Auth credentials to specific devices (APP_BASIC_AUTH_DEVICES)
Chatwoot: messages sent through the REST API (/send/*) are not mirrored to Chatwoot
MCP whatsapp_send: allow sending a local file (no way to attach media since private URL fetches are blocked)
History sync stores 1:1 chats under @lid when the LID map is still empty; timestamps mix +05:30 and +00:00 and are compared as text
⚡️ Label management endpoints: create/edit/delete labels and label/unlabel chats (WhatsApp Business)
⚡️ MCP download_media: option to return the media as MCP content blocks for remote clients
